Commentary.Commentary: The South African players make their way out in the middle. Followed by Lendl Simmons and Evin Lewis. George Linde to start with the ball.

So 168 is what West Indies need to take a 2-1 lead in this series. They have momentum on their side heading into the break and will hope the batters can chase this down. South Africa will be disappointed with the way they finished but they did manage to defend 166 a couple of days ago. Can they do it again? Join us for the chase to find out.

One of the star of the show with the ball, Dwayne Bravo is caught for a quick chat. Dwayne Bravo says that they knew the wicket tends to get slower as the innings progresses.  Adds that they came with a different plan today and gives credit to McCoy. Says that it is good to see a young player play well and contribute to the team. Mentions that they bat really deep but they respect South Africa's bowling line-up. States that they can't repeat the same mistakes they did in the second T20I.

West Indies will be pleased with their bowling efforts. They did not start off well but managed to pull things back towards the end. Obed McCoy was the star of the show. He once again impressed and finished with 4/22 from his 4. Bravo was the other bowler to get into the wickets column, finishing with 3/25. The spin duo of Sinclair and Allen were expensive but overall a very good display from West Indies with the ball.

Being put into bat, South Africa started off well but lost Hendricks and Bavuma inside the Powerplay. The Proteas plan looked to be bat around de Kock. The former skipper graced his 50th T20I innings with a very well made 72. Markram and van der Dussen provided good support. The tourists though failed to capitalize on the platform and ended up capitulating in the death. Scoring just 21 and losing 5 wickets in the final 3 overs.

36/5 from the final 5 overs and that has seen South Africa been restricted to just 167. At one stage it looked they would get something in excess of 180. West Indies will be happy with the way they have finished the innings. The Proteas will be gutted to lose 5/21 in the final 3 overs.
Fuller length outside off, Rabada plays it to mid off for a run. South Africa finish with 167 for 8.
Length delivery outside off, Rabada works it towards long off for a couple.

OUT! RUN OUT! Poor running between the two. Rabada is caught ball watching and it is Nortje who needs to pay the price.  Slower ball wide outside off, Rabada stretches and gets hit toe end of the bat. The ball goes to short fine leg. Nortje calls for the run and takes off. Rabada is ball watching and then sees Nortje is almost there. He looks to take the run but too late. The throw is at Holder and he does the rest.
Tabraiz Shamsi walks out to bat.
WIDE! Again the thought is right but the execution is a bit off. Slower ball but on the wrong side of the tramline.
WIDE! Slower ball wide outside off, but on the wrong side of the tramline.
On the pads, Nortje looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes to the on side. He takes a leg bye.
Slower ball outside off, Nortje swings but to no avail.
On the pads, Nortje flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
Anrich Nortje is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fuller length outside off, Rassie van der Dussen looks to hit it down the ground. He gets a thick outside edge instead. The ball goes towards Shimron Hetmyer who takes it easily at point. Obed McCoy has been exceptional today. He ends with a four-fer.
Commentary.Howout: c Shimron Hetmyer b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Way too outside off. Wide called.
SIX! HIGH AND HANDSOME! Short ball on middle, Rassie van der Dussen waits for the ball, pulls it over cow corner for a maximum.
Slower delivery outside off, van der Dussen drags it towards deep mid-wicket and grabs a couple.
On the pads, Rabada works it towards deep square leg for a single.
The new man in is Kagiso Rabada!

OUT! TIMBER! Obed McCoy and his slower balls have been pin-point today! Bowls another back of a hand delivery on leg, George Linde is completely foxed by it. He looks to flicks it to the leg side but gets defeated all ends up. The ball goes through his bat and disturbs the leg stump. His skills have been quite exceptional today.
Length delivery on leg, clipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Yorker length outside off, Linde jams it out to point. Excellent bowling from Dwayne Bravo. Two wickets and only 4 runs coming off it.
Dipping low full toss on off, Linde is again beaten as he looks to drive.
Fuller and outside off, Linde went for the drive but fails to get any bat on it.
George Linde walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Dwayne Bravo gets another! He comes over the wicket, bowls a slower one on off, David Miller gets a leading edge as he plays it to the off side. Lendl Simmons grabs the simplest of catches at point. Change of pace working well for Dwayne Bravo. South Africa falling apart.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Low full toss on leg, Miller flicks it towards backward square leg for a brace.
WIDE! Outside the tramline again. Wide called.
The new man in is David Miller!

OUT! CAUGHT! Dwayne Bravo gets the danger man! Good length delivery outside off, Quinton de Kock walks across the stumps looking to go over square leg. He miscues his shot and fell straight into the hands of Lendl Simmons who is inside the ring. Bravo has a knack for picking crucial wickets and gets an important one. De Kock departs after a well-made 72.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Slower ball way outside off. Wided.
Fuller and outside off, played towards mid on for a single.
Shorter and on middle, de Kock didn't middle it as he pulls this one away to long on. Another two taken.

DROPPED! Another slower one on middle, Quinton de Kock heaves it towards the long on region. Jason Holder covers a good ground to grab the catch. He puts in a dive but couldn't hold onto it. Two taken.
PLAY AND A MISS! Back of the hand delivery around off, de Kock gets beaten by the pace there as he looks to play.
Back of a length delivery around off, pulled towards deep square leg for a run.
Yorker length delivery on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Obed McCoy is back on! 2/5 from his 2 overs so far. Can he finish off well?
Slower ball on off, van der Dussen nudges it to mid-wicket. He keeps the strike with the single.
Full outside off, de Kock plays it to cover for one.

FOUR! Not off the middle but gets the job done! Full and wide outside off, de Kock stretches and gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball goes past short third man and to the fence. Brings up the 50-run stand too.
On middle, Rassie plays it to long on for one.
Review time! Rassie van der Dussen has been adjudged caught behind but he has decided to review it straightaway.

NOT OUT! Slower ball on leg, van der Dussen looks to sweep it away but took his eyes off the ball. The ball goes above the gloves and carries to Pooran behind the stumps. Bravo appeals for a catch and the umpire raises his finger. Rassie van der Dussen straightaway takes the review. Ultra Edge shows no spike as the ball passes the bat and the gloves. The on-field decision will be overturned.
Fuller on off,  de Kock lofts it over the bowler's head towards long off for one.
WIDE! Way outside off, de Kock leaves it alone. Wided.
Dwayne Bravo is back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-12-1.
Full and wide outside off, van der Dussen drives it away from long off and gets two again. This is good running.
Full toss outside off, de Kock misses out on it. He hits it to wide long off for a single.
Short ball on off, de Kock pulls it away from deep mid-wicket and gets a brace.
Length ball outside off, van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover and takes a quick single.
Outside off, van der Dussen plays it to the left of sweeper cover for a couple.
Slower ball on middle, de Kock plays it to long on for a single.
Andre Russell is back on.
Low full toss outside off, de Kock slices it to third man and keeps the strike.
Very full on middle, RvdD jams it to long on for one.
Full outside off, de Kock hits it to the left of short cover for a single.
Low full toss on the pads. Rassie clips it to fine leg for one.
Good length ball on off, de Kock pulls it but does not time it well to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball outside off, de Kock looks to slash but misses.
Jason Holder is back into the attack.
Length delivery around off, de Kock whips it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike. 10 off the over.
WIDE! Has to reload that one! Pollard misses his radar and bowls one down the leg side.
Full outside off, van der Dussen plays it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Innovative! Full outside off, van der Dussen decides early to play the reverse sweep. He gets in position and plays it through backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, clipped to the on side for one.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR DE KOCK! His purple patch continues! His 7th T20I fiffty. He has been a standout performer for the Proteas throughout this tour! Shorter on the body, de Kock swivels and pulls it through backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Full on middle, de Kock hits it away to long on and gets a couple.
Single to end the over. The last ball is full outside off, QdK milks it to long off and keeps the strike.
Full toss on the pads, van der Dussen turns it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Full on the pads, van der Dussen flikcs it but finds short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, de Kock stretches and plays it to deep point for a single.
On the pads, RvdD clips it to the on side and takes a single. Brings up the 100 for South Africa.
Dipping low full toss on middle and off. De Kock comes inside his crease and looks to paddle it. He gets the bottom edge on it and sends it to short fine leg for one.
WIDE! Bravo looks to go wide outside off, goes a little too extra wide.
Pitching outside leg! Full around leg, de Kock looks to hit it across the line but misses. The ball hits his pad and goes to the on side. Pollard appeal but to no avail.
Full around off, Rassie taps it to cover and takes one.
On middle and leg, de Kock tucks it to the on side for a single.
This time inside the tramline. van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover for one.
WIDE! Pollard misses his radar and bowls one well outside off, on the wrong side of the tramline.
Full around off, Rassie pushes it to cover.
Pollard starts with a length ball on the pads, de Kock turns it to the on side for one.
Kieron Pollard introduces himself into the attack.
Yorker length around off, van der Dussen digs it out. A wicket and 6 runs off it.

FOUR! A gift to Rassie van der Dussen! Shorter delivery on leg, Rassie van der Dussen pulls it towards fine leg. The fielder at the deep chases it and puts in a dive. But he touched the cushions as he pulled the ball back in. Van der Dussen will get a boundary. He is off the mark.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dwayne Bravo gets his first! Bowls a slower full toss on leg, Aiden Markram moves further on leg and looks to loft it over long off. He was in no control of that shot and didn't hit it with enough power. Fabian Allen at long off completes the catch to dismiss Markram.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and fuller outside off, de Kock pushes it through point for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, de Kock looks to slice it away but misses.
Fuller on leg, Markram whips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Dwayne Bravo is into the attack for the first time today.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Fuller on middle, Quinton de Kock hammers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Floated delivery on middle, Quinton de Kock makes room and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Fuller on pads, Markram works it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter on off, Aiden Markram cuts it past point and fetches himself a boundary.

NOT OUT! Tossed up on middle and leg, Quinton de Kock went for the scoop but misses. The ball goes off the gloves and then hits the pads. Allen and the keeper are interested as they appeal for an LBW. The umpire shakes his head. Pollard takes a review. Ultra Edge shows there is a spike as the ball passes through gloves. The on-field decision stays.
Review for LBW! Quinton de Kock is the man in question. The on-field decision is Not Out! Let's see what the replays have to say.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards covers for a single.
Low full toss, Markram mistimes it to cover for one.
SIX! High and handsome! Darted quicker and fuller around leg. Markram moves away from his stumps and launches it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Tossed up around leg, Markram hits it in  the air but away from the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller on the body, Markram hits it back to the bowler on the bounce. Pooran though was appealing for the catch but without any support.
Darted fuller on middle and leg. De Kock plays it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Markram uses his feet and comes down the track. He takes it as a full toss and hits it to long on for one.
Tossed up on middle, Markram clears his front leg and hits it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short around off, de Kock moves away from the stumps and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Flighted well outside off, Markram drags his sweep from there to play it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Floated on middle, Markram pushes it to short extra cover.
Tossed up on off, de Kock strokes it to long off for one.
Allen starts with a floated delivery around the pads. De Kock plays it through the cow corner region for a couple.
Change in bowling. Fabian Allen is on now.
Shorter on off, punched towards mid off. End of the powerplay. South Africa 51 for 2.
Flatter delivery on leg, flicked towards fine leg for another couple. 50 up for South Africa.
Fuller on middle, Markram hits it past the bowler towards long on. He bags a couple.
Tossed up on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
On leg, worked towards square leg.

Short on off, Quinton de Kock cuts it through point. Two fielders give it a chase and one of them pulls it back. De Kock calls for three and runs hard. The throw is at the bowler's end but missed the stumps. Three taken.
Aiden Markram replaces his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wickets in quick succession for West Indies! Back of a hand delivery on middle, Temba Bavuma charges down the track looking to go big. He completely mistimes his shot and the ball goes straight up in the air. Shimron Hetmyer calls for the catch and runs forward. He grabs it comfortably at the mid on region. Obed McCoy bags his second and Temba Bavuma departs for a timid score. South Africa lose two wickets inside the powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Shimron Hetmyer b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: On a length on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Bavuma went for the scoop but plays it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, Bavuma cuts it on the off side.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma defends it solidly.
Skipper, Temba Bavuma walks out at number 3!

OUT! TAKEN! Obed McCoy draws the first blood! Bowls a short ball on middle, Reeza Hendricks pulls it towards deep square leg. He didn't get the required elevation he needed. Fabian Allen at the deep runs to his right and grabs it with both hands. Hendricks has to walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Obed McCoy is back into the attack.
On middle, Hendricks knocks it to long on and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short on off, Hendricks shows great footwork. He gets on his back foot and punches it against the spin through extra covers for a boundary.
Flatter on middle, Hendricks punches it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Loose delivery and punished! Drag down on the body, Hendricks swivels it past backward point for a boundary.
Short and follows de Kock outside leg stump. Quinton knocks it to deep square leg for one.
Short on off, Hendricks punches it to long on for one.
Bouncer! Effort ball from Russell. He tumbles delivering that. De Kock looks to pull but retracts.
FOUR! That is clever from de Kock! Back of a length delivery on off, de Kock waits for it and then places it over short third man for a boundary.
Length ball around off, Hendricks punches it through covers for a single.
Full on off, de Kock moves away and places it through point for a single.
FOUR! Another poor delivery and once again gets the treatment it deserved! Full on the pads, de Kock whips it fine down the leg side for a boundary.

SIX! KABOOM! De Kock welcomes Russell with a biggie. This will annoy Russell. He starts with a half-tracker around the body. You do not bowl to de Kock there. He pulls it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Change in bowling.  Andre Russell now into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short ball on leg, Reeza Hendricks picks the length early, pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, worked down to deep square leg for another single.
Fuller length on leg, Hendricks flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Hendricks works it on the leg side.
On a length outside off, de Kock pushes it towards extra cover for a quick single.
Length delivery on off, Hendricks plays it towards backward point. He is off the mark with a single.
Slower and outside off, de Kock is beaten by the pace there. He looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. 7 runs off the first over.
Who will start from the other end? It will be Jason Holder!
FREE HIT! First one of the game and it will be Quinton de Kock who will have a shot at it.
NO BALL! A wayward full toss on leg, de Kock sits under it. The keeper fails to collect it and allows it to race away to fine leg fence. Bonus runs for South Africa. Free Hit coming up.
Short again on middle, de Kock sways away from it.
Length delivery on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Serves a short ball on middle, Quinton de Kock is late into his pull shot. The ball goes off the top edge towards the fine leg region. A couple of runs taken.
Full toss on middle, de Kock works it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on middle, de Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
The West Indies players make their way out in the middle. Followed by the South African openers -  Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks. Obed McCoy to begin the proceedings with the ball.

PITCH REPORT - Mike haysman is the pitch master for the game. Haysman says that it is a new pitch. Tells there will be little of turn and does not expect it to be tacky.  Haysman says that it is little hot today.Haysman says it is a good pitch and expects it is going to be a fun game.

Nichollas Pooran is caught for a chat. Pooran says it was good to get the victory in the first game. Credits South Africa for bouncing back in the last game and tells they have learned from their mistakes. Pooran says that th wicket got slower and tells he could have been more patient and tells he could have stuck around. Pooran says that the bowlers have been fantastic especially in the last quarter of the game and tells they come out and done well.

South Africa skipper, Temba Bavuma says that it was very pleasing to win the second game. Adds that they were able to adjust to the conditions in the second game. Mentions that the first 10 overs become very crucial. He further adds that 180 would be a very good score today. Informs that there is a single change as Markram comes in for Klaasen.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard, says that they will stick to bat second. Pollard says he does not think it was a fable performance. Tells they faltered and tells they have had a conversation about things they did wrong. Pollard says they are not concerned about the pitch and are looking to bowl better. Pollard informs there are two changes as Hetmyer and Simmons come in place of Gayle and Fletcher.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Lendl Simmons (IN PLACE OF ANDRE FLETCHER), Evin Lewis, Shimron Hetmyer (IN PLACE OF CHRIS GAYLE), Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder, Andre Russell, Fabian Allen, Dwayne Bravo, Obed McCoy, Kevin Sinclair.

South Africa (Playing XI) -  Reeza Hendricks, Quinton de Kock (WK), Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram (IN PLACE OF HEINRICH KLAASEN), David Miller, George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi, Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - Up goes the coin. It lands in the favor of West Indies. They elect to field first.

Hello and welcome to the third T20I between West Indies and South Africa. After leveling the series in the previous game courtesy of a much-improved display, the tourists will look to build on that momentum and take the lead in this series. The hosts will look to bounce back after a very abject display, especially with the bat. Pollard and co. will be desperate to show that it was nothing more than just a blip. We have another exciting contest waiting in the wings. Can the rebuilding South Africa take the lead or will the Caribbean power hitters bounce back? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
